title: Cardiac MRI in patients with end-stage ILD with strain analysis to assess myocardial contractility, texture, and perfusion pre- and post-lung transplantation
summary: In this study, we investigate the possibilities of cardiac magnetic resonance imaging to assess structural and functional differences in the cardiac muscle of patients with severe interstitial lung disease. Besides evaluating the cardiac function and cardiac strain we will detect slight increases in myocardial fibrosis, as they can occur in various heart diseases. The results will be compared with existing cardiac ultrasound examinations. By analyzing the collected data at the end of the study, we hope to discover new prognostic factors in order to be able to reduce serious complications for future patients.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- ILD (Interstitial Lung Disease) in terminal stage
- listing for lung transplantation
- clinical indication for MRI
- no contraindications to MRI
- age of at least 18 years
- ability to give written consent
Exclusion criteria:
- not MRI-compatible foreign bodies (if not MRI-conditional)
- pregnancy
- claustrophobia
- contraindication to administration of contrast agent containing gadolinium
- second or third degree of atrioventricular (AV) block or sinus node dysfunction
- unstable Angina pectoris that has not been stabilized with medical drugs
- severe hypotension
- decompensated stages of heart failure
